content.user_title: Prepare and Verify Poptin Email Campaigns
content.value_statement: Email campaigns require careful coordination of content, audience eligibility, and launch timing. This skill guides connected Poptin MCP workflows with verified drafts and explicit send or schedule confirmation.
actual_capabilities: Guide discovery of connected Poptin tools, account scope, enabled email features, and actual tool schemas.
Prepare campaigns from available gallery templates, saved templates, or supplied HTML when supported.
Define audience inclusion and exclusion rules, preserve subscription preferences, and distinguish segment matches from eligible campaign recipients.
Guide campaign draft creation, final launch review, and explicitly confirmed sending or scheduling through supported tools.
Check email content, unsubscribe controls, personalization fallbacks, and rendered previews when available.
Verify campaign state after mutations and reconcile ambiguous launch responses before considering retries.
limitations: Requires a separately connected and authorized Poptin MCP account with the necessary email features.
HTML import, tool names, rendering, and recipient snapshot behavior depend on the exposed MCP capabilities.
Does not provide cold outreach workflows or lifecycle automation design.
Contains workflow instructions and scenario checks, not a bundled sender or proof of live execution and email delivery.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Newsletter Draft
use_cases.description: Select an available template, apply approved content, preview eligible subscribers, and verify that the saved campaign remains a draft.

use_cases.title: Schedule an Approved Promotion
use_cases.description: Review the campaign audience, exclusions, sender, and exact timezone before explicitly confirming a scheduled launch.

use_cases.title: Review a Custom HTML Campaign
use_cases.description: Check supplied HTML and supported import capabilities, then use the connected tool or provide a Poptin UI handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Campaign Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my connected Poptin account and available email campaign tools. Report missing prerequisites without changing settings or sending email.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: establish account scope and available capabilities.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a newsletter draft using [approved copy] and an available saved template for [audience]. Preview eligibility and verify draft status. Do not send.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare content and audience without launching.

prompt_templates.title: Schedule a Reviewed Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Review campaign [ID] for [date], [time], and [IANA timezone]. Show final content, sender, audience, and timing. Request explicit confirmation before scheduling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate final review and an unambiguous scheduled launch.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve an Ambiguous Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: The launch request for campaign [ID] timed out. Reconcile its status and returned job identifiers through supported read tools. Do not resend or create replacements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate uncertain launch outcomes without duplicate sends.

output_examples.input: The segment matches 1,000 contacts, but the campaign preview shows 740 eligible recipients. Prepare the final audience summary.
output: Use the campaign eligibility count in the launch review.
Explain exclusions from returned tool evidence without changing subscription preferences.

output_examples.input: Use my supplied HTML, but the connected MCP tools do not expose an HTML import field.
output: HTML import is unavailable through the connected MCP tools.
Review the HTML and provide a Poptin UI import handoff.
Resume from the actual saved template or campaign ID after import.
Do not claim the file was uploaded or substitute another template.

output_examples.input: The send request timed out. Send the campaign again.
output: Read the same campaign and any returned job or request status before considering a retry.
Do not repeat the launch or create a replacement while its status remains unresolved.

best_practices: Inspect live tool schemas and use actual returned account, campaign, audience, and template identifiers.
Review the campaign audience preview and obtain explicit confirmation of final content, recipients, sender, and launch timing.
Read back each changed campaign and reconcile timeouts before considering any repeated launch operation.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, copy approval, or draft creation as permission to send.
Guessing tool names, HTML upload support, merge tags, or recipient eligibility from segment totals.
Retrying an uncertain send or creating a replacement campaign without reconciling the original operation.

faq.question: Does installing this skill connect my Poptin account?
faq.answer: No. Connect and authorize Poptin MCP separately through its supported OAuth flow. Do not share passwords, API keys, or tokens in chat.

faq.question: Can it send or schedule campaigns?
faq.answer: It guides those actions when supported by connected tools. Each launch requires explicit confirmation of the final campaign, audience, and applicable timing.

faq.question: Can it import my HTML email?
faq.answer: Only when exposed MCP tools support HTML import. Otherwise, it reviews the HTML and provides a Poptin UI handoff.

faq.question: Why can segment and campaign recipient counts differ?
faq.answer: A segment can match contacts who are not eligible for a campaign. The workflow uses the campaign audience preview and preserves consent and suppression rules.

faq.question: What happens if a launch request times out?
faq.answer: The workflow stops further launch attempts and reconciles the same campaign, job identifiers, and available logs before considering a retry.

faq.question: Does a sent status prove delivery?
faq.answer: No. It reports observed campaign or dispatch status. Accepted requests and completed dispatch do not establish inbox delivery.
